title: Show HN: Loböle, open-source parametric CAD that AI agents can drive
source_excerpt: I could never get used to FreeCAD, so I built my own. It turns out Claude is really good at using it. Loböle is a parametric B-Rep CAD built on OpenCASCADE and Vulkan, with sketches, assemblies, drawings, FEM and CAM. The GUI, Python scripts and AI agents all go through the same commands, so an agent can do anything you can in the GUI. The engine, watch and bicycle in the README were each built by Claude writing a script against it. Comments URL:
